newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Bus says in cooperation with TWR.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Bus says in cooperation with TWR.

text.p: The bus division of Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo confirmed a media report that it would cooperate with Britain's automotive enginnering consultancy TWR to develop chassis for buses.
"Yes, it is correct that we are beginning cooperation," Volvo Bus spokeswoman Kerstin Sterner told Reuters.
The London-based Financial Times newspaper said Volvo would put its chassis activities into a joint venture with TWR.
Sterner declined to elaborate on the details of the deal, saying the company would release a statement later about it.
Volvo has scheduled a news conference at its Uddevalla plant for 1000 GMT and a news release is due at 1100 GMT.
"We will hold a press conference in Uddevalla since this will have significance for the town as it will mean more employment possibilities," Sterner said.
Last year Volvo's car division and TWR set up Auto-Nova, which was a TWR-controlled joint venture to manufacture Volvo sports models at the Uddevalla plant.
